title: Quickstart visuals for Hosted API: model selector + request builder screenshots
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a set of production-ready onboarding visuals for the Hosted API quickstart. Deliverables: 1) model selector screenshots showing default, expanded, and selected states (with model tiers and latency badges), 2) request builder screenshots demonstrating form-based request composition, streaming toggle, and structured output preview, 3) code snippet panels for Python and JavaScript that match the UI examples, 4) annotated guidance overlays for docs. Acceptance criteria: images exported at 1440x900+2x, retina-ready PNGs, copyable code snippets match SDK v3, accessible alt text provided, assets uploaded to Drive and referenced in docs PR.
